outputs.explanation: Panel A shows representative bright-field and fluorescence images of lungs; it is not a plot of averaged data.
The bar graph shows mean ± SD but also overlays individual data points (blue dots for No Cre, red dots for Adeno Cre) for each biological replicate.
Panel C consists of histology/fluorescence/RNAscope images and spatial expression plots, not a plot of averaged summary statistics.
The GSEA enrichment plots display a running enrichment score curve derived from ranked gene lists, not an average of replicate measurements, so individual data points are not applicable.

The bar graph shows log2 fold-change values from a differential expression statistical test (Seurat FindMarkers) for each gene, a single computed value per gene rather than a mean of multiple replicate measurements, so individual data points are not required.
Panel F shows representative fluorescence and IHC images, not a plot of averaged data.
